==Flavor Text==

''All alone in the hardest shell. Where, little nut, is father tree and mother leaf?''

==About==

A {{i|Stray Chestnut}} can be found in the wild, or Picked from a {{i|Chestnut Tree}}, or found by chance when Rummaging though a {{i|Squirrel Stash}}. A {{i|Roasted Chestnut}} is obtained when using a Stray Chestnut with the {{i|Roasted Nuts}} recipe, additionally, with the [[Nut Orchards]] skill learned, a Stray Chestnut can be planted in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} to grow a Chestnut Tree. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Stray Chestnut can be stored in a {{i|NutSack}}.
